post.summary: Register for an event, without an account or signed in with one (Idempotency-Key required): 201 with the code; the same key and form again, or a signed-in guest already registered, returns the registration with 200
post.description: Without an account, phone is required and a new, unlinked guest profile is made. With a guest's access token, phone is ignored: the account's linked profile is used or created with its verified mobile. Same rules as staff entry: the event must be taking registrations, the ticket type active and a place free. Errors: 400 validation_error (e.g. headers.idempotency-key, a non-Ethiopian mobile), 404 unknown event, 409 privacy_notice_outdated (details.current), 409 idempotency_key_reused, 409 registration_closed (details.reason), 409 capacity_reached (details.scope), 400 ticket_type_required, 429 rate_limited (10 a minute per IP).

201.description: Success envelope: { success: true, data, meta?, message? }
